sourceConventions.head: Напряжения!M57:M74 are zero numeric literals; retained as a source-workbook boundary condition, not a strain measurement.
sourceConventions.faces: Напряжения!G57:H74 use the full corresponding recorded load in both cell faces, matching A57:A74 and Raw Data stage loads.
sourceConventions.baseline: Stage0 uses the actual zero recorded load at Raw Data!A19 with the same source head-zero/face-load boundary convention; there is no dedicated initial-baseline profile row.
sourceConventions.contradiction: Напряжения!C4:C21 = B4:B21 /2, while source force-profile G57:H74 retain the full load. The source contains conflicting conventions; the explicit profile convention is reproduced, not independently certified.

quantityInterpretation: Head/cell points are source boundary force increments in the source plotting convention; they are not additional strain-gauge observations or independently calibrated hydraulic force measurements.
